label: M37_mode1_low_hit_high_tier_redistribution
_note: M37 mode 1 target — Triple Diamond chassis + 5-tier wild fusion, 95% RTP standard mode.

Design direction (user-pinned 2026-05-05): 削减低倍率 wild-alone + anybar 共 ~10pp RTP, 重新分配到 grand-related (~5pp) + 3-of-kind base (~3pp) + major-alone (~0.7pp). 保倒金字塔 mini > minor > major > grand。降总 hit 从 21% → 16-17%, 把 RTP 重心更明显推到 Mid+High。
Per-reel marginal anchors (M37Cfg baseline -> new targets):
R2 major  : 1.83% -> 1.95% (boost 7%, max headroom under 1.3× minor floor)
R2 grand  : 0.08% -> 0.11% (boost 38% — still 'lifetime tier' but slightly less rare)
Hierarchy ratio guards: mini 3.55/minor 2.55 = 1.39 / minor 2.55/major 1.95 = 1.31 / major 1.95/grand 0.11 = 17.7 — all ≥ 1.3 floor.

Predicted bucket shape: ge1_lt5 from 15.5% to ~9% (low-mult cut), ge10_lt20 (peak) from 21pp to ~28pp (booster combos boosted), ge50-200 tail thicker (~+5pp), grand 1000× tier from 1 in 105k to ~1 in 75k (still lifetime). >1000× = 0 (paytable cap).
REJECT >1000× wins: ge5000 = 0 strict (paytable cap is 1000× via high7 × grand path).

_design_constraints.archetype: IGT Triple Diamond chassis + Lightning Link mini/minor/major/grand jackpot tier naming + M37Cfg published baseline reference
_design_constraints.bucket_shape_intent: Mid+High tilted bell, peak around ge10_lt20, ge100_lt200 secondary peak from booster combos, Grand 1000× still lifetime tier (1 in ~75k spins).
_design_constraints.per_mode_variation_mechanism: per-mode reel weight remapping on shared physical layout (26 stops, alternating B/N)
